audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with the packet at five of seven rows, in both layers: Level 1 read Skill (packet Shen), Level 3 read Shen (packet Skill), Level 6 read Skill (packet Kayle), First item read Shen (packet Kayle), 2+ items read Shen (packet Skill).
audit.why: The mirror audit (kayle__shen) states it aligned its chart to the packet in both layers. Leaving this side unaligned would render Shen and Kayle claiming the same rows, and mirror-fix.js would overwrite it anyway. The shape the packet describes is also the correct one: Kayle is melee and helpless at 1, both are fine at 3, and her spike is 6 through first item.
audit.corrected: All five rows flipped to the packet in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings moved to match (Level 1 5/10 to 7/10, Level 6 6/10 to 4/10, First item 5/10 to 3/10) and phases[2].why / phases[5].why / whys[2] rewritten so the captions argue the new sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four fields (spikes[3], whys[6], late, wants.foe[2]) claim Kayle's 'E flame waves' bypass or clear under Spirit's Refuge. Starfire Spellblade (E) is an on-attack effect — it rides the basic attack, so Spirit's Refuge blocks it along with the auto. The ability that actually ignores the zone is Radiant Blast (Q), a spell.
audit.why: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not spells. Telling a Shen his W is useless against Kayle's real damage inverts the one mechanical rule that decides how he stands in a trade — and the mirror audit already states the correct version on Kayle's page, so the two sides would have contradicted each other.
audit.corrected: Radiant Blast (Q) named as the spell that passes through W; Starfire Spellblade re-stated as an on-attack effect eaten with the auto. Applied in spikes[3], whys[6], whys[2], late, wants.foe[2], phases[2].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid tells the player to back off for Divine Judgment's '140-second cooldown'.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160/120/80. At the level 6 timing the text is describing, it is 160s — the advice is 20 seconds short of the real window it is selling.
audit.corrected: Corrected to 160s at rank 1 in mid, and the same number added to phases[5].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing in the content layer despite Celestial Blessing (W) being a flat 15s heal at every rank.
audit.why: Brief missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal for this matchup; the full layer mentions anti-heal in report[8] and breakdown.late but the lane-phase text never tells the player when it matters.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds before extended trades added to mid with the 15s flat cooldown.

edits.before: At level 6 Kayle gains Divine Judgment and transitions toward ranged form — she will use R the first time you genuinely threaten a kill, so bait it. Take a short skirmish to burn the R, back off for its 140-second cooldown, then re-engage for the real all-in. Use Stand United the moment a jungle fight or bot-lane skirmish breaks out — your global presence is worth more than winning a lane you already control, and denying Kayle the XP to accelerate through levels 11 and 16 is the real goal.
edits.after: At level 6 Kayle gains Divine Judgment and transitions toward ranged form — she will use R the first time you genuinely threaten a kill, so bait it. Take a short skirmish to burn the R, back off for its 160s rank-1 cooldown, then re-engage for the real all-in. edits.before: At two items Kayle is fully ranged with E flame waves she can spam through your Spirit's Refuge zone — you cannot win the straight 1v1 anymore. Do not try to duel her; instead use Stand United to decide fights elsewhere on the map before she arrives with her team. Your job in sieges and teamfights is to E-taunt her so she burns R on your tankiness rather than killing a carry, then your team collapses. She hard outscales you if the game goes long, so convert every early CS-lead and kill into objectives well before the 25-minute mark.
